title: runstate TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails its own control on Apple git 2.50.1
body: In the full (non -short) suite, maintenance_test.go:38 fails deterministically on a host with Apple git 2.50.1: a plain `git fetch` in the armed fixture repo starts no maintenance, so the control refuses and the full `make test` goes red on innocent trees. The fixture's arming (maintenance.loose-objects.auto=-1, autoDetach=false) appears to depend on the git version (the test cites CI's 2.55); either arm it in a way older git honours or skip with a stated reason when the control cannot be armed.
